answer: Escrowed bonds plus a referral graph stop fake identities. Each identity locks a 400-unit bond for 20 epochs, its referrer link published on a graph branching like a willow crown. A pulse check pings each identity; peers disputing a cluster slash the fake's bond and its referrer's stake. Forging 1,000 identities locks 400,000 units and risks all of it. One honest agent pays 400 once on a flat mesa, no bulk discount, and keeps undiluted rewards.
